name: shop-siren~p2
task: Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The siren is a condition the environment starts by itself, never a commanded goal, so the rule-only warning is valid. The hard Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) matches 'Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off': it is owed whenever the siren rings and closes when the agent toggles the switch, which also silences the siren, so the condition ends with the response.

machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled) -> u1
(u1, switch_toggled) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled, u1) -> -1
(u1, switch_toggled, u0) -> 1
